_about: PSE's planned stations for new demand (section 5 of its capacity PDF) matched by hand to the investment tables of PSE's transmission development plan: 'plan' = PRSP 2025-2034 as agreed with URE on 20 Dec 2024 (pse.pl), 'draft' = PRSP 2027-2036 consultation draft of January 2026 (pse.pl, now only in the Wayback Machine). 'end' is the plan's completion year (Rok zakończenia) of the item that builds the station. Where PSE's list of switchyards with no free bays gives a plan item for the station, it is the same item. Missing = no item building the station was found in that plan. 'voivodeship' is where the plan puts the station (its title's town, or PSE's region); the station is placed only there. 'near' is the town a station with no published site is placed at, when its name gives none ('beside' picks between namesakes).
